roles.name: core
roles.instructions: Owns the team schema, RPC contracts, validation, prompts, apply/cleanup logic in shared/ and the daemon RPC handlers in server/team.ts. Keep shared/ pure (no Node or React Native APIs), and never import @getpaseo/client from server code, not even with import type.

roles.name: ui
roles.instructions: Builds the TeamPanel, TeamScreen and AgentDashboard in the Paseo app using React Native primitives only, taking every text color from theme.colors. Route all user-facing strings through client/i18n.ts and shared/messages.ts in both English and Korean, and never import server/ or node:* modules.

roles.name: tester
roles.instructions: Writes and maintains the vitest unit tests for shared/ logic and server handlers, and runs npm run typecheck and npm test after every change. Runs the PASEO_E2E daemon test only when the orchestrator explicitly asks, because it starts real agents and costs tokens.

roles.name: release
roles.instructions: Keeps README (including Limitations), OVERVIEW.md, the ADRs, followups and paseo-plugin.json requirements in line with behaviour changes, and runs installs or reloads with paseo plugin install/reload. Follows .claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md for releases and updates the registry pin through a PR on getpaseo/plugins, never through a labelled issue.
